title: Quality of Contents is poor
text:
The items are typically chips, cookie wafers, etc.

For the price of the box, I was expecting more than pretzel sticks and small bags of chips. These are items you can buy or used to be able to buy at World Market or similar stores.

I held out for 3 months hoping it would get better but finally canceled because we typically always ended up throwing the items in the garbage. I did get one chocolate type bar and it was melted beyond recognition.

Very disappointed.
label: negative
